caption: The video captures a kitchen counter against a blue-grey tiled backsplash, its glossy black induction cooktop reflecting the objects placed upon it. A tall clear drinking glass filled with water stands near the center, a faint diagonal refraction line crossing its interior. To the left rests an empty rectangular glass baking dish. To the right, an oil dispenser and spice jars stand near the wall, while a small blue cup, a pink patterned mug, a wooden spoon and chopsticks rest on a wire rack. The water level and every item's position remain unchanged throughout the excerpt. A person's hand is partially visible at the right edge, its fingers occasionally appearing and receding against the wooden trim. The hand never contacts the glass, the dish, or the rack items, and no object is picked up, shifted, or removed. The diagonal line inside the glass holds its place, consistent with a static refraction.
relations: The hand at the right edge appears and recedes without contacting the glass, dish, or rack items.
The water level and diagonal refraction line inside the glass remain unchanged throughout the excerpt.
All objects on the glossy cooktop and wire rack maintain their initial positions and orientations.
